# Kern loading — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for Kern loading when the wait needs one treatment out of four behind a single prop. `kind` picks it: skeleton-list rows with `count`, a spinner, determinate-or-loop progress, or the shimmer-card dashboard composition — and there is no `size` prop, because each kind owns its own metrics. `label` names the wait, defaulting to Loading, and every kind renders a status region under that name, so the wait is announced however it is painted while skeleton rows stay decorative inside the one region. Progress with a value between zero and one reports real progress; a null value renders the indeterminate loop for unknown durations. The loader, circular progress, progress, meter and page loader stay separate components — each owns a different Material 3 meaning, and collapsing them would mislabel waits — and a measured scalar that is not a task is a meter rather than any of these.

## Native

### Features

Reach for Kern loading when the wait needs one treatment out of four behind a single prop — the native twin under the same contract. `kind` picks it: skeleton-list rows with `count`, a spinner, determinate-or-loop progress, or the shimmer-card dashboard composition — and there is no `size` prop, because each kind owns its own metrics. `label` names the wait, defaulting to Loading, and every kind renders a status region under that name, so the wait is announced however it is painted while skeleton rows stay decorative inside the one region. Progress with a value between zero and one reports real progress; a null value renders the indeterminate loop for unknown durations. The loader, circular progress, progress, meter and page loader stay separate components, each owning a different Material 3 meaning, and a measured scalar that is not a task is a meter rather than any of these.
